items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And I come up and I found that Edmund Hall's album they had released

ctx.x: They called them something else. And they -- no, this is so and so song.
And I come up and I found that Edmund Hall's album they had released, and they had took one of the pop songs and called it something else, you know. To keep from paying royalty on it.
And that's when they stopped -- they stepped in and we stopped --
